verdict.rationale: The pack contains first-party doc references to a server-side support page and to the BABYLON.NullEngine class, which indicates a headless, non-rendering engine mode the product itself ships. The items are only bare source URLs, though, with no content showing how unit or integration tests run in CI against the real engine. missing for 10: documented test-runner/CI workflow guidance, details of what NullEngine supports headlessly (scene logic, physics, asset loading), confirmation that tests exercise the real engine, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, tests run headlessly — unit and integration tests of game code execute in CI against the real engine
